scripts.dev: cd server && rm -f prisma/orderwas.db && npx prisma db push 2>&1 | tail -3 && npx prisma db seed 2>&1 | tail -3 && cd .. && concurrently "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.test: npm -w server run test && npm -w client run test
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm -w server run build && npm -w client run build
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
